items.body: Green, Jeremy: In Motion Canadian guitarist Jeremy Green returns with In Motion , another ripping set of instrumental, guitardriven fusion. Guitar lovers get exactly what they want here: a wide palette of sounds, smart arrangements, and consistently killer playing. As with his debut âStanding Eightâ, Green surrounds himself with elite musicians, and everyone gets room to shine. Take notice of drummer Keith Carlock (Toto, Wayne Krantz) featured on all eight tracks, his playing stands out, heavy when needed, tight and grooving always.
